newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SEEDORF SUCCEEDS IN BID FOR YELLOW CARD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SEEDORF SUCCEEDS IN BID FOR YELLOW CARD.

text.p: Real Madrid's Predrag Mijatovic and Christian Panucci failed in their bid to get themselves booked at the weekend but Dutch midfielder Clarence Seedorf succeeded.
All three players had said before Sunday's match against Zaragoza they would deliberately look for yellow cards so they could serve looming suspensions while they were on international duty.
Seedorf was the only player who succeeded. He was shown the yellow card for a challenge that will leave Zaragoza's Santiago Aragon out of action for three weeks.
"It was lucky for me but I didn't want it to come so early in the match," said Seedorf, who insisted the foul was not deliberate.
Zaragoza coach Luis Costa was unimpressed.
"It's a shame to go home with an injured player because another is looking for a card," he said.
Seedorf can now serve his Spanish suspension while away with the Netherlands, who face San Marino in a World Cup qualifier on March 29.
Pannuci is a member of the Italian party for their match against Moldova on the same day while Mijatovic is in the Yugoslav squad to face the Czech Republic on April 2.
